notes.title: March 19th Update
notes.notes:
New UI map guide (opened with M key)
Cancel the power outage operation of the elevator between the water plant and the medical area
Fix the bug in AI restoration of hospitals and water plants with default normal difficulty after exiting the game
Reduce the lock in period of 20% for the corrupt experimental body's punching punch (simple vs. normal mode)
Fix collision issues in the scene
Repair the black lace sock fitting mold
Repair the bunny girl jacket wearing mold
Fix the lens zoom bug caused by quick aiming with the right mouse button

notes.title: February 29th Update
